text:
Ava (People Ops): Quick question — heading to a 3-city conference in June. Need clarity on visa fees + per-diem when travel spans countries. Who should I cc on preapproval?

Jon Miller: cc me and Luca. We need the itinerary + estimated expenses. Are you booking on the company card or personal?

Ava (People Ops): Personal — cheaper flights on my card, company will reimburse. Also paying an expedited consular fee and a local transit visa for one leg.

Priya Shah: Reimbursements for mandatory visa fees are eligible if you include the consulate receipt. For expedited service, include the fee breakdown (standard vs expedited) so finance can audit.

Luca - Finance: Confirming — visa/consular fees are reimbursable when tied to business travel. Upload the scanned receipt or PDF from the embassy. If you pay online, the payment confirmation + card statement is fine.

Ava (People Ops): For per-diem: do we get a full day per-diem for travel days between cities, or pro-rated? One leg leaves at 6am and lands 11pm same day (long transit).

Jon Miller: Policy: first and last day are pro-rated. For long transit days where >8 hours in travel, you can claim a full per-diem for that intermediate day — mark it in the preapproval form and include flight times.

Priya Shah: Also note local per-diem rates vary by country. Use the higher-rate country for that date if you end the day in that country. Attach the Lodging + meals estimates.

Ava (People Ops): What about ATM cash for local transport/tips where no receipt available?

Luca - Finance: Small cash expenses (under local equivalent of $25) can be covered with an attestation and the ATM withdrawal receipt. For larger amounts, we need itemized receipts. Keep a photo of receipts in-case.

Ava (People Ops): Lost boarding pass for one leg — only have airline email confirmation. Will that work?

Priya Shah: Email itinerary and the e-ticket/PNR is acceptable. For meal/per-diem claims tied to that segment, annotate the claim with the flight segment.

ExpenseBot: Reminder: Submit a Travel Preapproval form here: https://redwood.company/travel-preapproval and attach: itinerary, visa receipts, itemized lodging, and expected per-diem breakdown. Missing docs delay reimbursements. :memo:

Ava (People Ops): Thanks — I'll submit now and CC Jon + Luca. Anything else?

Jon Miller: If you expect >$1,000 out-of-pocket, request an advance. Mention "multi-country conference" in subject.

Priya Shah: And keep embassy consulate reference letters if asked by auditors (rare, but helps).

Luca - Finance: I'll pre-clear the visa fees once form is in. We'll confirm currency conversion method (bank rate on the date of transaction).

Ava (People Ops): Awesome, filing it now. :raised_hands:
